title: Saudi Arabian Roast Lamb
description: A flavorful and aromatic dish inspired by Saudi Arabian cuisine, featuring a deliciously seasoned roast lamb.

ingredients.name: Herbed Lamb Shoulder
ingredients.notes: Ask your butcher to have it prepared with the herbs

ingredients.name: Arabian Spices
ingredients.notes: Mix of cumin, coriander, cinnamon, cardamom, and black pepper

instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, lemon juice, garlic, ginger, and Arabian Spices.
Add the lamb shoulder to the marinade, turning to coat evenly. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or overnight.
Remove the lamb from the refrigerator and let it sit at room temperature for 30 minutes.
Place the lamb on a roasting pan and rub the roast all over the lamb.
Roast the lamb in the preheated oven for 20 minutes per kilogram, or until it reaches an internal temperature of 145°F (63°C) for medium-rare.
Let the lamb rest for 15 minutes before slicing and serving.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve with your favorite sides.
